<!--
  Adding a mod (.rmod) to the pack. Easiest way: in the Mod Manager, select your mod and click
  📤 Share Mod — it opens this page in the right folder and you just drag your file in.
  On the next build your mod is bundled into the app and shipped to everyone.
  (Got a bug or an idea instead? Open an Issue.)
-->

## Your mod

**Name:**

**What it does:** (a line or two)

**Which game version (branch)?** <!-- e.g. public — it's shown at the top of the Mod Manager -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Everything I added is a `.rmod` file (one or more) — nothing else changed.
- [ ] It's in the `source/example_mods/` folder for that game version (the Share Mod button does this for you).
- [ ] I tested it in-game and it works.
- [ ] It's my mod, or I have the author's OK to share it.
- [ ] I'm OK with the maintainers updating my mod as the game changes, so it keeps working on the **public** branch.
